title: Usage counts: The Signature 3D Asset Specification Database Database (3d-asset-specification-database-signature)
body: Usage figures for The Signature 3D Asset Specification Database Database (3d-asset-specification-database-signature). USAGE METRICS (all derived from the live manifest data/manifest.json and the data-file inventory; no invented numbers): record_count = the database's record_count field; edition_siblings = other databases in the same edition group (same subject root after stripping signature-/public-/-signature/-public affixes) minus 1; topic_cluster = number of databases sharing the same record_kind; link_count = edition siblings + xdb_pulls entries + (1 if the entry carries a page or page_url); usage_score = round(record_count * (1 + log10(1 + link_count)) + 100 * edition_group_size). Record count: 25. Edition siblings: 1 (same subject, other editions). Topic cluster: 2 databases share its record kind '3D asset spec'. Link count: 1 (edition siblings + cross-database pulls + page links). Usage score: 233.
